narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>More numbers go on top each time, so the fractions keep getting bigger.
<bookmark mark='grow'/>The tops are one, four and nine. The bottoms are three, twelve and twenty seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The bottom grows too, and a fraction depends on both parts, not on the top alone.
